shortDescription: US ultra low-sulfur diesel futures ICEEUR:UHO1! fell more than 5% after Politico reported the Trump administration is preparing a plan to ban diesel exports for 90 days.The October futures contract was trading at $4.7199 a gallon, down 4.5%.
